items.title: 9.6.3 Developing Communication and Storytelling Skills (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of developing communication skills (PDF 220).

items: Baqaidagi se mashq kar ke aitmaad barhayein.
Sameen ko jaanein: paigham hum jamaaton, asatiza ya khandan ke mutabiq dhalein.
Visual aids: tasveerein, khaake aur props kahani wazeh karte hain.
Wazeh aur mukhtasar: ghair zaroori tafseel chhorein.
Awaz aur taasurat se jazbat dikha kar asli lagein.

blocks.text: Martin Luther King Jr. ki 'I Have a Dream' taqreer apne paigham ke saath andaaz-e-bayan ki wajah se bhi yaad ki jati hai: kahani, jazbat aur wazeh baat ne use na-qabil-e-faramosh banaya (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Brand banane aur gahakon se jurne mein baat cheet aur storytelling ka kirdar bataiye (long question 7).
blocks.explanation: Wazeh baat cheet gahakon ko batati hai ke brand kya deta hai aur un ki raye sunti hai, jis se bharosa banta hai. Storytelling brand ko shakhsiyat aur jazbati maani deti hai, jaise bani ka safar ya gahak ki kamyabi, to log use yaad rakhte aur jura mehsoos karte hain. Ishtiharat, social media aur khidmat mein in maharaton ka istemal khareedaron ko wafadar gahak banata hai jo brand ki sifarish karte hain.

items: Behtari: mashq, sameen ko jaanna, visuals, mukhtasar, jazbat.
